2609.31160.title: ReG-SAM: Reference Graph-Driven SAM for 2D Foundational Vessel Segmentation
2609.31160.paper_summary: Vessel segmentation in medical images is essential for many clinical tasks, ranging from diagnosis to treatment planning. However, it remains challenging due to complex vascular morphology and diverse imaging conditions. Existing deep learning methods rarely aim at building a generalizable vessel segmentor across anatomies and modalities. While the Seg- ment Anything Model (SAM) has shown promise for med- ical image segmentation, its original design does not fully exploit vascular morphology and struggles with fine-grained vascular structures, leading to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose ReG-SAM, a SAM-based framework tailored to 2D vessel segmentation that leverages reference graph set for enhancing vascular representations. Specifically, we introduce two modality-aware representations derived from the reference masks: graph prompt embeddings (GPEs) that encode global spatial features from graphs, and vascu- lar prototype embeddings (VPEs) that capture fine-grained modality-specific vessel characteristics from multi-scale fea- ture maps and vascular masks. Since both require vascular masks that are unavailable during inference and require robust modality-aware vascular feature representations, we construct a modality-wise vascular database and develop two reference graph-guided representation learning schemes for estimating GPEs and VPEs using samples from the database rather than ground-truth masks. Extensive experiments across 19 datasets demonstrate that ReG-SAM consistently outperforms existing baselines, even those using manual prompts, particularly on challenging thin vessels.
2609.31160.paper_summary_zh: 醫學影像中的血管分割對於許多臨床任務至關重要，從診斷到治療計劃。然而，由於複雜的血管形態和多樣的成像條件，這仍然是一個挑戰。現有的深度學習方法很少旨在構建一個能夠在不同解剖結構和模態之間通用的血管分割器。雖然分割任何模型（Segment Anything Model, SAM）在醫學影像分割方面顯示出潛力，但其原始設計並未充分利用血管形態，並且在處理細緻的血管結構時表現不佳，導致性能不理想。在本文中，我們提出了ReG-SAM，一個基於SAM的框架，專門針對2D血管分割，利用參考圖形集來增強血管表示。具體來說，我們引入了兩種來自參考掩模的模態感知表示：圖形提示嵌入（graph prompt embeddings, GPEs），它編碼來自圖形的全局空間特徵，以及血管原型嵌入（vascular prototype embeddings, VPEs），它捕捉來自多尺度特徵圖和血管掩模的細緻模態特定血管特徵。由於兩者都需要在推理過程中無法獲得的血管掩模，並且需要穩健的模態感知血管特徵表示，我們構建了一個模態特定的血管數據庫，並開發了兩種參考圖形引導的表示學習方案，使用來自數據庫的樣本而非真實掩模來估計GPEs和VPEs。在19個數據集上的廣泛實驗表明，ReG-SAM始終優於現有基準，即使是那些使用手動提示的基準，特別是在挑戰性的細血管上。
